eval_data.text: A CI/CD system defines deployment pipelines. All pipelines must run 'Build' and 'Unit Test' stages. A 'Staging' deployment is mandatory and can only run after 'Unit Test' passes. For 'Production', the user can select either a 'Blue/Green' or 'Canary' strategy. Choosing 'Canary' automatically adds a 'Monitoring' stage with a 'Rollback' trigger. Choosing 'Blue/Green' requires double the infrastructure resources during the swap. eval_data.text: A smart home automation system links devices based on rules. A rule has triggers, optional conditions, and actions. Rules must have priorities to resolve conflicts: the 'Movie Mode' scene (sets lights to 10%) must block the 'Morning' scene (sets lights to 100%) from running. Safety constraints are critical: the 'Smart Oven' action is disabled if 'Home Status' is 'Away'. Also, the 'Air Conditioner' action is dynamically disabled if any 'Window Sensor' reports 'Open' and only re-enables 5 minutes after all windows are closed.
eval_data.output:
features
    SmartHomeAutomationSystem {abstract}
        mandatory
            Rule
                optional
                    Conditions
                optional
                    Actions
        alternative
            "Movie Mode" Scene {priority 1}
                mandatory
                    Trigger
                        literal "Movie Time"
            "Morning" Scene {priority 2}
                mandatory
                    Trigger
                        literal "Good Morning"
        alternative
            "Smart Oven" Action
                mandatory
                    Condition
                        literal "Home Status" equals "Home"
        alternative
            "Air Conditioner" Action
                mandatory
                    Condition
                        expression "!All Window Sensors equals Open"
                alternative
                    Action
                        literal "Turn On Air Conditioning"
                        duration 5 minutes

constraints
    "Movie Mode" Scene => "Morning" Scene disable
    "Smart Oven" Action => "Home Status" equals "Away" disable
    "Air Conditioner" Action => "All Window Sensors equals Open" disable
    "Air Conditioner" Action => "All Window Sensors equals Closed" enable
